description: This file is a C header (.h) defining a private interface for Wi-Fi scanning operations within the nl80211 subsystem. It includes licensing information, a header guard, and a declaration for a single external function `wld_nl80211_hasStartedScan`.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_hasStartedScan
methods.description: Function to check whether a scan has been started for a specific wireless interface identified by `ifIndex` and `wiphyId`. It takes a reference pointer `pRef` for context, an unsigned 32-bit wireless PHY identifier, and a signed 32-bit interface index, returning a boolean result.
